paragraphs: Rabbah bar Ulla. Shabbat 83b; Eruvin 93b. To Rav Yosef. He spoke to Rav Bibi bar Abaye: Eruvin 8, end of a. Ulla, or in another version Rabbah bar Ulla, reported a teaching of R’ Yohanan (Rosh Hashanah 31b). Rava bar Rav Ulla expounded: Shabbat 31b; there, 77b: bar Ulla. Bava Batra 74b; Eruvin 90b; Yevamot 62b: Rava. Shabbat 62b; Bava Kamma 87b; Avodah Zarah 64a: Rava bar Ulla. He spoke to Ulla: Yevamot 77a. In Hagigah 25b he disagrees with Ulla, and an elder tells him, ‘Do not disagree with Ulla, for we learned a Mishnah like his view.’ Rav Pappa bar Aha bar Adda in his name (see there, for the reading differs). Rav Shmuel bar Aha in his name. Also Abba bar Surmaki (I have not found this; see Rav Haviva bar Surmaki).
